paite: Nou namte aw, bil a za ding in hong nai un; michihte aw, ngaikhia un; leitung leh asung a om tengteng in bil in za uhen; khovel leh asung a pan pawt tengteng toh.
heading: Pathian In Amelmate Asawi Ding
english: Come near, you nations, to hear! Listen, you peoples. Let the earth and all it contains hear; the world, and everything that comes from it.

paite: TOUPA'N nam chiteng tung a lungkimlouhna nei in asepaihte uh tengteng tung ah lah hehna anei ngal a; amau ahihmang vek a, thah ding in apeta hi.
english: For Yahweh is enraged against all the nations, and angry with all their armies. He has utterly destroyed them. He has given them over for slaughter.

paite: Alak ua thah a omte paihkhiak in a-om ding ua, aluang namsia uh apaitou vutvut ding a, tangte asisan ua zulsak in a-om ding uhi.
english: Their slain will also be cast out, and the stench of their dead bodies will come up; and the mountains will melt in their blood.

paite: Van a omte tengteng hihman in a-om ding ua, laibuzial kizial bang in van zial in a-om ding a, a-omte tengteng, grepgui a kipan a nahvuai apulh bang in leh theipi kung a kipan a nahvuai apulh bang in avuai khin un apulh vek ding uhi.
english: All of the army of the sky will be dissolved. The sky will be rolled up like a scroll, and all its armies will fade away, as a leaf fades from off a vine or a fig tree.

paite: Ka namsau in van ah taitak in adawnta ngal a, ngai in, huai vaihawm ding in Edomte tung ah leh ka hamsiat mite tung ah ake ding.
english: For my sword has drunk its fill in the sky. Behold, it will come down on Edom, and on the people of my curse, for judgment.

paite: TOUPA namsau sisan in atai ding a, thauna a thausak in a-omta, belamnoute leh kelte sisan in, belampa gilthaute in. TOUPA'N Bozrah ah kithoihna anei a, Edom gam ah leng thahna thupitak anei hi.
english: Yahweh’s sword is filled with blood. It is covered with fat, with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams; for Yahweh has a sacrifice in Bozrah, And a great slaughter in the land of Edom.

paite: Gam bawngtalte leng kituak in satpaih in a-om ding ua, bawngtalte toh, agam un sisan akham ding a, aleivui uh thauna a thausak in a-om ding.
english: The wild oxen will come down with them, and the young bulls with the mighty bulls; and their land will be drunken with blood, and their dust made greasy with fat.

paite: TOUPA phulak ni lah ahita ngal a, Zion selna lam thu athukna kum.
english: For Yahweh has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.

paite: Aluituite longnai dia suahsak in a-om ding a, leivuite mei leh kaat asuak ding a, agam longnai kang asuak ding hi.
english: Its streams will be turned into pitch, its dust into sulfur, And its land will become burning pitch.

paite: Sun leh zan in mihsak ahi kei ding a; ameikhu lah tangtawn in atungkah ding a; suan om lai siah asia in a-om nilouh ding a; tangtawn in leng kuamah in angap kei ding uhi.
english: It won’t be quenched night nor day. Its smoke will go up forever. From generation to generation, it will lie waste. No one will pass through it forever and ever.

paite: Tuivagik leh sakuh in huai gam atang ding ua; simbu leh va-ak huai ah ateng ding uh; siatna khau leh siatgawpna ulum atung ah akhai ding hi.
english: But the pelican and the porcupine will possess it. The owl and the raven will dwell in it. He will stretch the line of confusion over it, and the plumb line of emptiness.

paite: Amihoihte uh gam uk ding in asam ding ua, himahleh huai ah kuamah sap ding a-om kei ding uh; amilian tengteng uh bangmah ahi kei ding uh.
english: They shall call its nobles to the kingdom, but none shall be there; and all its princes shall be nothing.

paite: Akumpipa uh inn ah louling neite apou ding a, akulhpi sung uah dailing leh lingnok apou ding; sehalte tenna ding leh vasa ngawngsaute a ding in inn um sung intual ahi ding hi.
english: Thorns will come up in its palaces, nettles and thistles in its fortresses; and it will be a habitation of jackals, a court for ostriches.

paite: Huan gamdai a, gamsate ngiate toh akituak ding ua, sathak in alawm asam ding; ahi, zan thil lauhuaipi in huai ah omna abawl ding a, amah a ding in khawlna mun ding amu ding hi.
english: The wild animals of the desert will meet with the wolves, and the wild goat will cry to his fellow. Yes, the night creature literally, lilith, which could also be a night demon or night monster shall settle there, and shall find herself a place of rest.

paite: Huai ah simbu thupi in bu abawl ding a, atui dia, akeuh ding a, a-opkhawm ding; ahi, huai ah mute koppih nei chiat in a-omkhawm ding uhi.
english: The arrow snake will make her nest there, and lay, hatch, and gather under her shade. Yes, the kites will be gathered there, every one with her mate.

paite: TOUPA laibu ah zong unla, sim un; huaite lak ah khat leng kim lou a-om kei ding a, khat leng koppih nei lou a-om kei ding; amah kam ngei in thu apia a, akha ngei in huaite apikhawmta hi.
english: Search in the book of Yahweh, and read: not one of these will be missing. none will lack her mate. For my mouth has commanded, and his Spirit has gathered them.

paite: Ama'n lah amaute a ding in ai asansak a, akhut a khau a teh in huai gam ahawmsak chiat a; tangtawn in anei ding ua, suan om lai teng huai ah a-om ding uhi.
english: He has cast the lot for them, and his hand has divided it to them with a measuring line. They shall possess it forever. From generation to generation they will dwell in it.
